name: Speed Sprint
window_note: Seven target build days after setup on September 9. Work advances on request, not automatically with the calendar.
goal: One inspectable public-source learning mission across all four pillars, with a Hermes-first portable core and explicit local/cloud boundaries.

source_of_truth.mode: Versioned project metadata; local browser notes are never authority.

triggers: I feel the need for speed

work_policy.max_scope: One smallest coherent eligible step per user invocation.
work_policy.execution: Explicit user request only; no background scheduler.
work_policy.blocked: Record the hold and select only an independent eligible step. Never bypass a held tool operation.
work_policy.authorizations: No automatic merge, release, policy change, credentials, provider spending, private-data transmission or clinical activity.

baseline.evidence_note: Prior CI evidence recorded in the current PR; tests were not rerun by the planning dashboard.

pillars.name: Knowledge
pillars.gap: Managed evidence workspace and learner understanding unproven.

pillars.name: Judgment
pillars.state: Review safeguards tested in synthetic scope

pillars.name: Capability
pillars.gap: Real governed Hermes mission and operational portfolio save unverified.

pillars.name: Contribution
pillars.gap: Professional review, private portfolio and reuse outcomes pending.

tasks.title: Speed Sprint control board
tasks.human_need: A repeatable next step, visible progress and explicit holds instead of plans lost in chat.
tasks.deliverable: Seven-day plan, trigger runbook, updated existing Seed Garden Kanban and local launcher.
acceptance: Preserve every existing seed and original growth categories.
Persist the plan and authoritative status in the existing repository on a review branch.
Test task selection, dependency validation, browser interactions and loopback-only serving.
Do not represent a local dashboard as installed on the user’s device or as a released clinical product.
tasks.weakens: A dashboard can reward task count instead of useful outcomes; maturity and release remain separate.
tasks.next_action: Read the current source baseline and begin SS-01 on the next explicit sprint request.
evidence: JavaScript ledger and preservation checks: 13 passed.
Chromium offline-view checks: 12 passed; browser-to-localhost blocked by environment policy.
Existing kanban and seeds reconstructed with matching Git blob hashes before additive changes.

tasks.title: Make the mission portable
tasks.human_need: A nurse should keep the same learning goal and professional records when the interface, model, or hosting arrangement changes.
tasks.deliverable: One thin, responsive learning-workspace shell plus versioned mission records and local / hybrid / hosted-test deployment manifests.
acceptance: A public/synthetic learning goal opens on desktop and narrow mobile viewports.
Records use stable IDs independent of Hermes sessions and model-provider conversations.
Three manifests distinguish interaction, harness, authoritative storage and inference locations.
Unknown deployment, source classification or endpoint fails validation; no network inference runs.
Existing schemas and held files remain unchanged; regression evidence accompanies a draft change.
tasks.scope: Local prototype, synthetic fixtures, no account setup or provider spend.
tasks.weakens: Architecture overhead can delay nurse value; the deliverable must include a visible mission, not only diagrams.
tasks.next_action: Read the current catalog code and source baseline; specify the minimal MissionRecord and three deployment manifests before coding.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Make evidence inspectable
tasks.human_need: A nurse needs to examine what a resource actually says, what it applies to, and what it does not establish.
tasks.deliverable: A small versioned public-source learning pack, passage-level evidence cards and a focused glossary within the mission workspace.
acceptance: Use 3–5 inspected primary-source passages with revision, passage locator and rights/reuse notes.
Evidence, generated synthesis, inference and missing information display as different states.
Broken references, changed passages and unsupported claims remain visible rather than becoming sourced badges.
Corpus selection is checked before retrieval; unknown/nonpublic inputs are refused in this prototype.
A nurse can point to a passage and explain one limitation; human check remains pending until actually observed.
tasks.scope: Public-source corpus only. No patient stories, employer files or private memory.
tasks.weakens: Citation labels may be mistaken for truth; hash matching proves integrity, not semantic support.
tasks.next_action: Create a tiny fixed corpus and claim-to-passage test cases; build evidence cards before expanding search.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Protect the nurse’s thinking
tasks.human_need: The nurse must form an interpretation and be able to disagree, revise or withhold a decision before producing a resource.
tasks.deliverable: A commit-then-compare workbench with initial interpretation, alternatives, evidence gaps, consequences and a recorded human choice.
acceptance: Learning flow records initial interpretation or explicit uncertainty before revealing a labeled proposal.
No preselected AI verdict; accept, revise, reject and withhold are genuine alternatives.
Changing the evidence or proposal preserves prior decisions and requires a new comparison record.
A planted omission, conflicting evidence and persuasive unsupported suggestion appear in regression cases.
Keyboard navigation and narrow-screen use are checked; no competence score or hidden reasoning is inferred.
tasks.scope: Synthetic comparison first; no consequential execution.
tasks.weakens: Excessive forms can exhaust users; a reflection record is not proof of independent judgment.
tasks.next_action: Implement the decision state transitions and learner-first view; evaluate reject/withhold paths as first-class outcomes.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Connect Hermes without lock-in
tasks.human_need: A nurse can use the preferred desktop environment without surrendering professional records or granting its agent unrestricted authority.
tasks.deliverable: A pinned Hermes interface assessment and a narrow runtime bridge for the same learning mission.
acceptance: Record exact upstream repository, commit, interfaces and separate code/model/data rights.
Use a configuration/adapter or companion workbench before considering a fork.
Hermes receives only admitted context for one bounded stage; core records remain in Nurse AI OS.
Missing hooks, broad tools, unverified cancellation or bypass paths block runtime activation.
When Hermes is unavailable, the mission still opens and manual learning continues; a fixture is not reported as a live integration.
tasks.scope: Isolated read-only or proposal-only integration; no unrestricted terminal, scheduled jobs or credentials.
tasks.weakens: A profile or prompt may be mistaken for containment; bridge tests must distinguish advisory and enforced controls.
tasks.next_action: Assess the exact runtime interface against the adapter contract; implement only the smallest supported route.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Prove model substitution
tasks.human_need: The nurse should not lose their work, source context or ability to challenge the output when the model changes.
tasks.deliverable: Typed inference requests/results, capability-aware routing and a reproducible local-versus-cloud adapter comparison harness.
acceptance: Permission and allowed destinations filter models before suitability, latency and cost.
Unsupported tool/structured-output features, timeouts and refusals produce explicit outcomes.
No local failure silently uploads context to cloud; private reflection stays excluded.
Compare identical public/synthetic tasks, source pack and budget across two adapters; label recorded/stub results honestly.
Live local/remote comparison runs only with available approved endpoints and an explicit spend ceiling; otherwise report it pending.
tasks.scope: No new paid APIs or transmission of personal data; live provider calls conditional.
tasks.weakens: API compatibility may be mistaken for equivalent capability; comparison must include omissions and human review cost.
tasks.next_action: Extend the existing model-router contract; test routing denials and no-silent-fallback before invoking real models.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Prepare a truthful portfolio save
tasks.human_need: A nurse needs a portable, attributable resource and a reliable answer to whether it was actually saved.
tasks.deliverable: Versioned portfolio record and acceptance/failure suite; a real private save only after all prerequisite gates are satisfied.
acceptance: Bind owner, destination, content hash, source versions, decision, AI disclosure and review status.
No successful save receipt unless read-back confirms the expected persisted artifact.
Duplicate, interrupted, stale-approval, revoked, unavailable-audit and unknown-outcome cases are specified and tested as permitted.
Private record and public contribution remain separate; nothing is submitted or published automatically.
If clean CI or identity/authorization is unresolved, deliver contract and test fixtures only; actual save remains blocked, not marked complete.
tasks.scope: Contract/test preparation is independent. Operational portfolio writes require G-01 and G-02.
tasks.weakens: A polished artifact can be mistaken for competence; a simulated receipt can be mistaken for persistence.
tasks.next_action: Specify the ActionIntent-to-ExecutionReceipt mapping and failure cases without enabling a write path prematurely.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

tasks.title: Show the whole mission; decide the next bet
tasks.human_need: The product should demonstrate useful, understandable work for a nurse, including those who only have a phone or tablet.
tasks.deliverable: An integrated demonstration, hosted-readiness assessment, formative evaluation kit and evidence-based next-sprint recommendation.
acceptance: Run the implemented learning stages end to end; show any blocked save as blocked, not as a completed mission.
Demonstrate the same portable records in local and narrow-screen hosted-test configurations; no public cloud release implied.
Target 3–5 formative nurse walkthroughs if participants are available; record actual denominators, not assumed results.
Measure accepted artifact, material omissions, explanation of source/model/save locations, stop/recovery and total review effort.
Report full relevant tests, known lint hold, real-model gaps, user-feedback gaps, and go/revise/hold separately.
tasks.scope: Local or expressly authorized isolated staging only; no external deployment, marketing launch or live accounts.
tasks.weakens: A successful demo can conceal missing validation; do not claim product, security or clinical readiness from prototype tests.
tasks.next_action: Assemble the available stages, run the defined evaluation cases and identify the single highest-value next improvement.
tasks.owner: Development agent; Robert reviews product value

gates.title: Clean CI + maintainer review
gates.reason: 20 lint findings remain in seven held files. Earlier tool-level safety holds are not bypassed or retried through another route.
gates.resolution: Resolve issue #16 through the permitted maintainer process; verify fresh full CI and human review before release or operational portfolio activation.

gates.title: Runtime identity + enforced authority
gates.reason: Deployed revision, reviewer identity, approval binding and complete Hermes boundary mediation are not established.
gates.resolution: Assess the exact runtime; verify authenticated identity, admission, cancellation, egress and approval controls before activating consequential capabilities.

gates.title: Live model / cloud test access
gates.reason: No live endpoint credentials, provider budget, tenant infrastructure or staging authorization supplied for this sprint.
gates.resolution: Use fixtures without new external spend. Live evaluation or hosting needs approved endpoints, an explicit budget and scoped authorization.

history.detail: Existing Seed Garden source inspected; catalog PR and issue #16 checked. Seven target build days proposed with no release gate relaxed.
Plan and local board prepared; 36 Python tests, 13 JavaScript assertions and 12 offline browser checks passed. No build-day task, release or portfolio execution claimed.
